rationale: Deep cinematic dark mode is selected to merge the exclusivity and mystery of 'Luxury/Premium' with the stadium-night intensity of 'Energetic/Bold' sports. We are using Archetype 2 (The Performance Pro) combined with Archetype 5 (Luxury) elements.

typography.rationale: Outfit (sans-serif) offers geometric, wide, and aggressive styling for massive sports-impact headlines without feeling like a generic template. Manrope provides crisp, technical legibility for body text, ensuring a premium finish.
hierarchy_rules: H1 (Hero): text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]. Never exceed this size.
H2 (Section): text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-none.
Overlines/Labels: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#DFFF00].

rules: No pure #000000. Base background is #050505 (Deep Obsidian).
No generic full-screen gradients. Color exists only to guide action.
Use #DFFF00 (Volt Yellow) for primary CTAs and active states, paired with pure black text for maximum contrast.
Use #0044FF (Electric Blue) sparingly as an accent for links or subtle gradient blooms behind images.

surfaces: Sticky Header: Crystal Glass (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10).
Cards (Featured Events): 1px border-white/10 with #0A0A0A background. On hover, apply an inner glow or elevate shadow.
Hero Overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/70 to-transparent. Let the background image breathe on the right side.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle global SVG noise/grain overlay (mix-blend-overlay, opacity-10) to kill digital flatness and create a premium print/film vibe.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton on the Features/Services grid by using border-collapse style layouts with 1px border-border/40 separating items.

components: Hero Section: Pure Tailwind HTML (no Shadcn). Overlapping bento items, massive typography.
Marquee: Use 'react-fast-marquee' for the 'Editorial Ribbon' of partnered events.
Featured Events Bento Grid: Pure Tailwind grid.
Contact Form: Shadcn UI (Input, Textarea, Button), stripped of vercel defaults. Input background #111, border #333, text #FFF. Focus state ring should be Volt Yellow (#DFFF00).
Icons: lucide-react (stroke-width 1.5 for a sharper, premium look).

grids_layouts.hero: Asymmetrical split. Text heavily anchored to the left taking 60% width, allowing the background action image to dominate the right.
grids_layouts.bento_grid: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid for Events. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8.
grids_layouts.bento_spans: Hero Event (Football): col-span-full lg:col-span-8 row-span-2. Square Events (Tennis/Tomorrowland): col-span-4 row-span-1. Tall Event (Olympics): col-span-4 row-span-2. Fillers: col-span-4 lg:col-span-4.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 to py-32 for section wrappers. Container max-width should be expansive (max-w-[1400px]).
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text. Asymmetry creates tension. Avoid standard centered text blocks.

motion.scroll: Install and use 'lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site a premium, heavy feel.
motion.interactions: Use 'framer-motion' for staggered entrance of the Bento Grid items (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0).
motion.hover_states: All buttons must scale (scale: 0.98) on click. Hovering on event cards should scale the background image slightly (scale: 1.05) and darken the overlay to reveal event dates.

accessibility.contrast: Volt Yellow (#DFFF00) buttons must use black text to meet APCA contrast ratios.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (CTAs, form inputs, submit button) MUST include data-testid.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion settings.

hero_background.description: Stadium full of people watching a soccer game. Anchor to the right.

luxury_flight.description: Plane parked beside the trees on seashore.

luxury_hospitality.description: Table with food and glasses on it (Premium hospitality).

event_tennis_cricket.description: A dense crowd of people in a stadium.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly required for this conversion-heavy landing page. Rely on high-quality 2D imagery with Framer Motion parallax to keep performance high. If you implement 3D, use `framer-motion` 3D elements for ticket passes or VIP cards that tilt on mouse movement.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `@fontsource/outfit` and `@fontsource/manrope`. Update Tailwind theme to use them.
Do NOT use standard HTML inputs. Use Shadcn Form, Input, and Button for the lead capture section.
Make sure the navbar is fixed, wrapped in `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40` and has a 1px `border-white/10` bottom border.
For the Bento grid, use raw Tailwind HTML (divs), not Shadcn cards. Use group/hover classes so when hovering over a card, the image scales and dark overlay intensifies.
For the Marquee, use a pale #1A1A1A background with pure white uppercase text, separated by star icons, drifting slowly.
Ensure the hero background image is absolutely positioned behind the hero text, with a horizontal gradient overlay so text is perfectly readable on the left.
Add `data-testid` to navigation links, the primary 'Get a Quote' buttons, and all form inputs.
Create a 'Noise' component (a fixed div with pointer-events-none and an SVG noise pattern background) overlaying the entire site.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. ALWAYS use provided images or real icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Hover state text contrast MUST be maintained.
Do not use completely transparent backgrounds for drop-down menus or sticky navs. Content underneath will make text unreadable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Headings must have tight letter spacing, body text must have relaxed line-height.
